name: Hyundai Elantra N DCT
notes: Calibrated from Elantra N DCT captures. 2.0.5: power/torque enabled - EMS16 TQI (0x260 D1) x0.390625, referenceTorqueNm 500, staticFrictionTorquePct 6.5. 2.0.6: rpm-dependent frictionTorqueCurve added (measured live TQFR 4.7%@2750 to 11.7%@5700 on the 2026-08-02 VN MT WOT capture, same G4KH engine; 6800 rpm tail point extrapolated); flat 6.5% overstated top-end power by ~5%. staticFrictionTorquePct kept as fallback for older apps. powerGaugeMaxHp 360. 2.0.7: RPM reverted from 0x162 to 0x366 D1:D2 (same as MT). The 2.0.0-2.0.6 '2025 CGW relocation' claim was wrong: 0x366 carries clean RPM on every EN capture 2022-2025, both transmissions (6 EN cars incl. a 2025 DCT at odo 8281 km; Kona N logs corroborate the same gateway layout), while 0x162 D1:D2 is NOT a plain RPM word: during DCT shift bursts (~0.6 s, 62% within 400 ms of a gear change) bit15 AND bit14 carry shift-phase flags and even the masked low bits deviate up to ~1800 rpm from true RPM - no bit mask makes 0x162 safe, do not resurrect it (16-bit reads produced the 14,692 rpm / 732 hp session-peak bug). removeSignals retires the stale (EngineRPM_2,0x162)/(FuelLevel,0x5CD) keys on overlay-composing app builds whose bundled tree predates 2.0.7; both entries are no-ops against this tree.
